app.title: Wispr Flow: AI Voice Keyboard
app.text:
Talk naturally. Flow writes perfectly. Trusted by business leaders, creatives, students, and professionals to boost productivity every day.

Wispr Flow is the AI voice keyboard and speech to text app built for speed and accuracy. It works inside any app—including Slack, Messages, Email, WhatsApp, ChatGPT, and Docs—instantly turning your spoken words into polished, formatted writing. Whether you’re taking quick notes, drafting long messages, or capturing detailed transcriptions, Flow is 4x faster than typing.

results.title: Great idea, not always so flawless execution
results.body: This app was initially super great for quick wordy responses to my clients but as I used it more I noticed that if Wispr Flow is open in the background, Siri is unresponsive until I force quit the app. I've also noticed it often freezes and I have to force quit it and reopen the Messenger app to send a message. This is especially true if I'm sending a picture attachment and want to write a comment under it with Wispr Flow. Half the time it usually crashes. Overall, really solid with some annoying quirks

results.title: This is a game-changing, life-changing app.
results.body: I have used and purchased this app multiple times, and if you are willing to use it, it can change your life. If you're willing to accept that maybe you're going to look more annoying and you're going to be like one of those D-bags at the store talking on their phone, you just get past that. You just realize that you're going to get more done. You can get more input through your mouth. I've just found that, for me at least, it's a much more efficient way to output data, to be creative, to build something, to reorganize. It's just a better throughput. I wish that I could use my local models and find some way to do this myself, since Wispr is open source. The bottom line is they put a lot of work, effort, money, and, most of all, good engineering into this app, and it's the best that's out there. It's just a fact, and it's really a great app.

results.title: Best voice dictation app ever
results.body: By far the best AI voice dictation app you could possibly buy in 2026. I've tried other competitors, but none of them are as good as Wispr Flow. I've also tried doing it myself with advanced local models, but it still doesn't even come close to the amazing user experience on Wispr Flow and the speed and accuracy. It's well worth the price that you have to pay each year for this, and I highly recommend this app. I would recommend that their team add more privacy controls.

results.title: Love it
results.body: I love this app. I'm amazed at how much I use it, definitely more than I first anticipated. The one thing that I do wish it had was that I could launch the note taker from my phone the way that you can in Otter. That's really the only thing that it seems to be missing, especially when you compare note-taking in Wispr Flow versus note-taking in Otter. You can launch Otter straight from your phone. This is important because some meetings might be via Zoom or Teams, but some meetings are still held in person. For those in-person meetings, it's nice when you can have a portable note-taking application. For right now, I'll still be using Otter for those features.
